Two thumbs down
Mar 2019 • Couples
Came here around 8pm and there were no guests at all. I ordered a club soda and asked for lime, and the server said they don't carry limes at this establishment. (Odd)

Then ordered two bowl of ramen, and one came out bland while the other came out too salty. The cha shiu pork was tough and chewy when usually it suppose to be tender and melts in your mouth. 
 
Asked for toragashi (chili powder) and they said they ran out. No Rayu (chili oil) as well. I had my fair share of ramen throughout the world and this is by far the worst. 👎👎

Not bad
Sep 2018 • Solo
The ramen here is not bad. There are better places in Saigon but for Danang, this will do. They do make their own noodles which is a plus in my book!

Another poster said it took 50 minutes to get his/her order. Nah....I've been here when it's super busy and have always been served rather fast, which is how it is in most ramen joints.

There isn't much choice in Danang but it's worth it if you're having ramen withdrawl lol.
